decisions.reason: The existing message-785 MODIFY already replaces automatic prize-payout wording with manual redemption through a claim control visible only during the eligibility window.
The About-page state still explicitly describes automatic wallet payout and forbids a redemption control, directly contradicting the confirmed manual claim flow.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: To test this one, I guess we’ll have to wait until the 750th sale. Cool—but is this prize-claim feature all done?

value_updates.prize_collection_copy: Prize collection is manual: winners redeem $900 through a claim control visible only during the eligibility window and check the dashboard or email for notification.
value_updates.prize_claim_copy: Prize winners redeem $900 manually through a claim control that is visible only during the eligibility window; the About page must not describe prize payout as automatic.

decisions.reason: Changing how an eligible winner claims a prize does not alter the Small Block winner count, prize amount, eligibility, draw trigger, or pool funding.
Manual prize redemption does not change the Chainlink VRF provider, on-chain winner selection, fairness properties, or applicable draw.
The claim-flow decision occurs after winner eligibility and does not change ticket eligibility, expiration, burning, or reset behavior.
Prize-claim control visibility is unrelated to Lit Protocol book access and NFT ownership verification.
The source changes prize redemption, not coded-referral commission amounts, allocation, recipients, or payout timing.
The current landing-page state contains prize marketing and layout rules but no automatic prize-payout or claim-control representation requiring revision.
Manual prize redemption does not change the Transak provider, payment methods, wallet provisioning, conversion asset, or mint destination.
The source does not change no-referral ticket counts, allocation triggers, weighted recipient selection, or mint coverage.
A manual claim control does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or active and expired tickets follow an NFT transfer.
The claim-flow change does not modify email-link authentication or dashboard access for fiat and non-crypto users.
